power_dissipation_at_85c.document: STMicroelectronics STM32H743xI datasheet, DocID030538 Rev 3 (October 2017), served by LCSC for C114408
power_dissipation_at_85c.shows: Table 23: power dissipation at T_A = 85 degC for the suffix 6 version, 915 mW in the LQFP144 row, and the suffix 6 ambient range of -40 to 85 degC at maximum power dissipation. 85 + 0.915 x 43.7 = 125, so ST's own three figures are consistent with the 125 degC junction limit and this is what pins that down.

power_supply_scheme.document: STMicroelectronics STM32H743xI datasheet, DocID030538 Rev 3 (October 2017), served by LCSC for C114408
power_supply_scheme.shows: Figure 13, Power supply scheme, with each decoupling value against the pin it belongs to: VDD gets N x 100 nF plus one 4.7 uF where N is the package's VDD pin count, VCAP 2 x 2.2 uF, VDDLDO 4.7 uF, VDDA 100 nF + 1 uF, VREF+ 100 nF + 1 uF, and VDD33USB and VDD50USB 100 nF each

thermal_characteristics.document: STMicroelectronics STM32H743xI datasheet, DocID030538 Rev 3 (October 2017), served by LCSC for C114408
thermal_characteristics.shows: Section 7.9's equation T_J max = T_A max + (P_D max x theta_JA) and Table 126 beside it, where the LQFP144 20x20 mm 0.5 mm pitch row reads 43.7 degC/W. It is the figure the board's declared ambient is derived from.
